test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The mother asked the daughter, "Can we buy tonight’s dinner from the restaurant?”

options.text: The mother asked the daughter could they buy that night’s dinner from the restaurant.
The mother asked the daughter if they could buy that night’s dinner from the restaurant.
The mother asked the daughter if they can buy tonight’s dinner from the restaurant.
The mother asked the daughter if could they buy that night’s dinner from the restaurant.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The mother asked the daughter if they could buy that night's dinner from the restaurant."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given interrogative sentence is in the direct speech.
 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for interrogative sentence conversions.
 
 
• Inverted commas are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed to "asked, demanded, ordered, enquired" as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• To make the indirect speech for questions that can be answered in YES/NO, the word "if" or "whether" is used before the reported speech within the sentence.
 
• "Can" changes to "could."
 
• Structure__:
 
 
• (Can + Subject+ V1 + Object?) (Direct Speech)
 
• (If + Subject + could + V1 + Object ) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *He said to me "Can you help me?"*
 
• *He asked me if I could help him.*
 
 
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence:* The mother asked the daughter if they could buy that night's dinner from the restaurant.*
